# sreagent_certificate_monitor (Resource)

Watches a TLS certificate's expiry. Needs the security plan feature. Rows cannot be edited, so any change replaces the monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sreagent_certificate_monitor" "api" {
  hostname         = "api.example.com"
  warn_days_before = 21
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) The host to check.

### Optional

- `check_interval_hours` (Number) Hours between checks; default 24.
- `critical_days_before` (Number) Critical this many days before expiry.
- `port` (Number) 1 to 65535; default 443.
- `warn_days_before` (Number) Warn this many days before expiry; default 30.

### Read-Only

- `days_until_expiry` (Number) Days left on the certificate.
- `discovered` (Boolean) Whether a sweep created it.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether checks run.
- `expires_at` (String) The certificate's notAfter.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `last_checked_at` (String) When it was last checked.
- `last_error` (String) The latest check's error.
- `last_status` (String) The latest check's verdict.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax, or with an `import` block
naming the same ID. See the [importing guide](../guides/importing.md).

```shell
# Collections import by id.
terraform import sreagent_certificate_monitor.api 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
